_meta.purpose: Hard-to-find, parent-facing insights on summer camps and enrichment programs — captured opportunistically during ESMS grinder runs.
_meta.schema: sections[] each with id, title, items[] of {label, detail}

sections.title: Field Notes — Hidden details from K-8 summer camp research
sections.description: Specific, actionable parent-facing insights surfaced during program verification. Most recent at top. Capped at 30 items.

items.label: Curious Cardinals — Pricing only revealed after intake call
items.detail: Curious Cardinals (curiouscardinals.com) does not publish pricing on its public site; tier costs are disclosed only after a 30-minute parent intake call. They do offer a 2-week 100% money-back guarantee, so committing then exiting if it doesn't fit is low risk (added 2026-04-26).

items.label: Connected Camps — $12/session club tier is the underused value
items.detail: Most parents only see the $65-$140 weeklong Minecraft camp tier on connectedcamps.com, but the $12-per-session 'Summer Clubs' tier provides ongoing 60-90 min mentored Minecraft/Roblox sessions for ages 8-17 — a cheap way to sustain interest year-round after summer camp ends (added 2026-04-26).

items.label: Code Ninjas — Stack AM + PM half-days into full-day with supervised lunch
items.detail: Code Ninjas franchises run AM camps 8:30am-12pm and PM camps 12:30pm-4pm; families can register for both at the same location and most centers will supervise the lunch gap, effectively converting two half-day registrations into a full working-parent day (added 2026-04-26).

items.label: AoPS Academy Virtual — Placement test required and is itself a free diagnostic
items.detail: AoPS Academy Virtual Campus summer camps require a placement test before enrollment. The test is free and is one of the better short math diagnostics available — even families who don't enroll can use the result to calibrate their child's actual math level vs. school grade (added 2026-04-26).

items.label: Brain Chase — Early-bird $199 for full 5-week summer program
items.detail: Brain Chase's full 5-week Summer Treasure Hunt (~4 hrs/wk academic challenges) is $199 at early-bird pricing; price increases as June 15, 2026 start date approaches. Cheapest comparable structured online enrichment program found this run (added 2026-04-26).

items.label: Outschool — Class quality is per-teacher, not platform-wide
items.detail: Outschool is a marketplace of independent teachers; quality varies dramatically by individual listing. Always read individual teacher reviews and check Outschool's verified-teacher badge before enrolling. Mini-group cap is 12 students per session — anything significantly above that is a red flag (added 2026-04-26).
